subject.title: fix(official): require verified ownership for newly allowlisted official org handles

question: Should this stale member-authored trust-boundary PR be reworked on top of current main's exact `officialPublishers` row model, or should the useful route-reservation portion be split into a fresh PR?
rationale: The original handle-derived Official fix is obsolete on current main, but the branch still touches publisher creation, route reservations, specs, and package-manager behavior in a security-sensitive area.

options.title: Split route reservation work
options.body: Keep the current row-scoped Official model and ask for a narrow current-main PR only for any still-missing route-reservation aliases, without `package-lock.json`.

options.title: Rebase and redesign
options.body: Require the author or maintainer to rebase and rewrite the branch around `officialPublishers` rows before any further review.

options.title: Close as obsolete by maintainer choice
options.body: A maintainer may decide current main fully supersedes the security fix and close this branch manually.

recommendation.title: Split route reservation work
recommendation.body: Keep the current row-scoped Official model and ask for a narrow current-main PR only for any still-missing route-reservation aliases, without `package-lock.json`.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-main history owner for the row-scoped Official model and adjacent admin command path.
